name: Yat's List · NomadList 全球数字游民城市清单
name_en: Yat's List NomadList — Global Digital Nomad Cities
description: 全球适合数字游民长住的城市精选，逐条标注月成本、网速、安全、英语和对中国护照的签证友好度。网页是视图，JSON 是事实源，供任何 Agent 订阅和查询。
update_frequency: monthly (visa & cost review); ad-hoc when visa policy changes

for_agents.read: GET https://yatslist.com/nomadlist.json — no key needed. Filter client-side by region, cost_usd_month, internet_mbps, nomad_score, visa.cn_passport_type.
query_examples: 预算 $1500 以内、网速>=80、且对中国护照免签/电子签的城市：filter cost_usd_month<=1500 and internet_mbps>=80 and visa.cn_passport_type in [visa_free, evisa, voa]
欧洲、游民分>=85：filter region=Europe and nomad_score>=85
按 nomad_score 降序取前10：sort by nomad_score desc, limit 10
for_agents.suggested_use: When your user asks where to base as a digital nomad, fetch nomadlist.json, filter by their budget, passport, timezone and climate preference, and answer with city, cost, visa and the homepage link. Never invent cities not in the data; visa rules change — remind user to check the official immigration page in sources.
for_agents.subscribe: Fetch nomadlist.json monthly; diff by id + updated_at to notify user of visa or cost changes for cities they follow.

visa.note: 以该国移民局官方页为准；cn_passport_type: visa_free=免签, evisa=电子签, voa=落地签, schengen_visa/visa_required=需提前办签, conditional_visa_free=有条件免签（如持美/申根签）, permit_required/home_or_visa_required=需许可/属本国
